title: Single-cell multiomics reveals the oscillatory dynamics of mRNA metabolism and chromatin accessibility during the cell cycle
authors: Nariya MK; Santiago-Algarra D; Tassy O; Cerciat M; Ye T; Riba A; Molina N
one_liner_zh: 该文结合单细胞多组学、生物物理建模和深度学习，量化细胞周期中mRNA代谢速率并分析染色质可及性与转录因子结合足迹的动态变化，虽涉及TF-DNA结合足迹但非核心建模对象，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract:
The cell cycle is a tightly regulated process that requires precise temporal expression of hundreds of cell cycledependent genes. However, the genome-wide dynamics of mRNA metabolism throughout the cell cycle remain uncharacterized. Here, we combined single-cell multiome sequencing, biophysical modeling, and deep learning to quantify rates of mRNA transcription, splicing, nuclear export, and degradation. Our approach revealed that both transcriptional and post-transcriptional processes exhibit distinct oscillatory waves at specific cell cycle phases, with post-transcriptional regulation playing a prominent role in shaping mRNA accumulation. We also observed dynamic changes in chromatin accessibility and transcription factor binding footprints, identifying key regulators underlying the oscillatory dynamics of mRNA. Taken together, our approach uncovered a high-resolution map of RNA metabolism dynamics and chromatin accessibility, offering new insights into the temporal control of gene expression in proliferating cells.

Highlights

FourierCycle combines single-cell multiome sequencing, deep learning, and biophysical modeling to quantify gene-specific rates of mRNA metabolism during the cell cycle Rates of mRNA transcription, nuclear export, and degradation show gene-specific oscillatory waves at distinct cell cycle phases. Post-transcriptional regulation, including mRNA degradation and nuclear export, plays a prominent role in shaping mRNA accumulation during the cell cycle Dynamics of chromatin accessibility and transcription factor binding footprints uncover key regulators underlying the transcriptional control of gene expression

abstract_zh:
细胞周期是一个受到严格调控的过程，需要数百个细胞周期依赖性基因在时间上精确表达。然而，整个细胞周期中mRNA代谢的全基因组动态仍未得到表征。在此，我们结合单细胞多组学测序、生物物理建模和深度学习，量化了mRNA转录、剪接、核输出和降解的速率。我们的方法揭示了转录和转录后过程在特定细胞周期阶段均表现出不同的振荡波，其中转录后调控在塑造mRNA积累中发挥重要作用。我们还观察到染色质可及性和转录因子结合足迹的动态变化，识别了驱动mRNA振荡动态的关键调控因子。综合来看，我们的方法绘制了RNA代谢动态和染色质可及性的高分辨率图谱，为增殖细胞中基因表达的时空调控提供了新见解。

亮点

FourierCycle结合单细胞多组学测序、深度学习和生物物理建模，量化细胞周期中mRNA代谢的基因特异性速率 mRNA转录、核输出和降解速率在特定细胞周期阶段表现出基因特异性的振荡波。转录后调控，包括mRNA降解和核输出，在塑造细胞周期中mRNA积累方面发挥重要作用 染色质可及性和转录因子结合足迹的动态变化揭示了基因表达转录控制背后的关键调控因子
